Effects summarized.

choiceGroups.black-star: Azura gives one star or the other.
choiceGroups.vile: You keep the axe or give it back for the Masque, not both.
choiceGroups.hircine: Killing Sinding gives the Hide; sparing him gives the Ring.

items.name: Azura's Star
items.effect: A reusable grand soul gem for the souls of creatures.

items.name: The Black Star
items.effect: A reusable black soul gem that can hold the souls of people as well as creatures.

items.name: Dawnbreaker
items.effect: Adds fire damage, deals extra damage to undead, and can make undead burst into flames.

items.name: Ebony Blade
items.effect: Absorbs health with each hit and grows stronger as you kill people who trust you.

items.name: Ebony Mail
items.effect: Muffles your movement while sneaking and poisons nearby enemies.

items.name: Mace of Molag Bal
items.effect: Drains Magicka and Stamina with each hit and soul traps enemies killed soon after.

items.name: Rueful Axe
items.effect: Drains Stamina with each hit. Yours only if you use it to kill Barbas. Not counted as a Daedric artifact.

items.name: Masque of Clavicus Vile
items.effect: Better prices, +10 Speech and faster Magicka regeneration.

items.name: Mehrunes' Razor
items.effect: A small chance to kill an opponent instantly.
items.note: You can choose gold instead.

items.name: Oghma Infinium
items.effect: Reading it permanently raises one group of skills by 5 each.
items.note: The book disappears after one reading.

items.name: Ring of Namira
items.effect: +50 Stamina, and feeding on corpses briefly boosts Health and its regeneration.

items.name: Sanguine Rose
items.effect: Summons a Dremora to fight for you for a time.

items.name: Savior's Hide
items.effect: Resist 15% of magic and 50% of poison.

items.name: Ring of Hircine
items.effect: Change into a werewolf any number of times a day.
items.note: For werewolf characters.

items.name: Skeleton Key
items.effect: A lockpick that never breaks.
items.note: Returned at the end of the Thieves Guild quests (Darkness Returns).

items.name: Skull of Corruption
items.effect: Deals more damage when charged with dreams taken from sleeping people.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.effect: Blocking raises a ward that absorbs up to 50 points of spell damage.

items.name: Volendrung
items.effect: Absorbs 50 Stamina with each hit.

items.name: Wabbajack
items.effect: Casts a random effect, from turning the target into a cheese wheel to healing it.

items.name: Drainblood Battleaxe
items.effect: Absorb 15 points of health.
items.where: A Drainblood Battleaxe is a translucent Honed Ancient Nord Battle Axe wielded by some of the ghostly draugr found within Labyrinthian. It is a part of a set of similar phantom weapons, alongside the Drainheart Sword and Drainspell Bow.

items.name: Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls
items.effect: If target dies within 5 seconds, fills a soul gem.
items.where: The Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls is a unique steel battleaxe located on the back of Warlord Gathrik's throne in Ironbind Barrow. Its unique enchantment does ten points of fire damage over one second, and soul traps the target for five seconds.

items.name: Tsun's Judgement
items.effect: Target takes 50 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
items.where: Tsun's Judgement is a unique battleaxe. It is acquired through the Battle of the Champions quest.

items.name: The Woodsman's Friend
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: The Woodsman's Friend is a unique iron battleaxe found alongside a dead wood cutter. With no enchantment and no way to improve the weapon through blacksmithing, the only advantage this weapon has over the generic version of this weapon is the single extra point of default damage it can do.

items.name: Angi's Bow
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Angi's Bow is a hunting bow given to Angi by her now deceased family. Tempering Angi's Bow requires one steel ingot, with the improvements being twice as effective should you have the Steel Smithing perk.

items.name: Bow of the Hunt
items.effect: Animals take 20 points of extra damage.
items.where: The Bow of the Hunt is a hunting bow found on an altar, next to a copy of the Archery skill book Vernaccus and Bourlor, inside Clearspring Cave. This bow has a unique enchantment that does an additional twenty points of animal damage.

items.name: Drainspell Bow
items.effect: Absorb 15 points of magicka.
items.where: A Drainspell Bow is a translucent Supple Ancient Nord Bow wielded by some of the ghostly draugr found within Labyrinthian. It is a part of a set of similar phantom weapons, alongside the Drainblood Battleaxe and Drainheart Sword.

items.name: Firiniel's End
items.effect: Target takes 20 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
items.where: Firiniel's End is an elven bow that is left in a convenient location to perform the assassination of Vittoria Vici during her wedding by Gabriella, as part of Bound Until Death. The bow is enchanted to do twenty points of frost damage upon strike, while also slowing the target by fifty points for three seconds.

items.name: Froki's Bow
items.effect: Does 10 points of Stamina damage.
items.where: Froki's Bow is a long bow that was made by and was the weapon of choice of Froki Whetted-Blade that he lost within Graywinter Watch. The bow has an enchantment that does ten points of stamina damage.

items.name: Glass Bow of the Stag Prince
items.effect: Wielder receives an increasingly powerful blessing for every 20 animals killed by the bow.
items.where: The Glass Bow of the Stag Prince is a glass bow wielded by Falas Selvayn, who can only be found at the Ramshackle Trading Post between the hours of 12am and 5am. It is identical to a normal glass bow, except that it deals one additional damage.

items.name: Karliah's Bow
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Karliah's Bow is the version of the Nightingale Bow used by NPCs, such as Karliah and Nightingale Sentinels. It shares its appearance with the player version, although it lacks its enchantment and is worth less gold.

items.name: Zephyr
items.effect: Fires 30% faster than a standard bow.
items.where: Zephyr is a unique Dwarven bow that belonged to Katria before she fell down a cliff to her death inside of Arkngthamz. The bow itself rests at the top of a ravine, precariously perched on the side of a fallen tree.

items.name: Blade of Sacrifice
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: The Blade of Sacrifice is a ceremonial ebony dagger given to you by a Priestess of Boethiah as part of Boethiah's Calling. She will give the dagger with the intention that you use it to kill a follower on the Altar of Sacrifice located at the Sacellum of Boethiah, as part of a ritual to summon the Daedric Prince.

items.name: Blade of Woe
items.effect: Absorb Health 10 points.
items.where: The Blade of Woe is a unique dagger belonging to Astrid, the leader of the only remaining Dark Brotherhood group in Skyrim. It can be received in three ways: pickpocketing from Astrid, killing Astrid during the Quest With Friends Like These..., or at the end of the quest Death Incarnate.

items.name: Bloodthorn
items.effect: If target dies within 3 seconds, it fills a soul gem.
items.where: Bloodthorn is a steel dagger found upon a sacrificial altar atop Hag's End in the grasp of a dead witch. Its enchantment soul traps a target if the target dies within three seconds after being hit, as well as draining health from the injured party for ten points.

items.name: Borvir's Dagger
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Borvir's Dagger is the weapon found beside its late eponymous owner, Borvir, inside Journeyman's Nook. Its appearance and stats are identical to those of an elven dagger, only being notable due to its unique name and owner.

items.name: Dragon Priest Dagger
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: A Dragon Priest Dagger is a type of dagger associated with the Dragon Cult. They can be found in the Hall of Countenance, Volunruud Elder's Cairn, Volkihar Keep, and Ysgramor's Tomb.

items.name: Nettlebane
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Nettlebane is a unique, crudely-engraved ebony dagger, originally made by hagravens to sacrifice spriggans. Compared to the typical ebony dagger, Nettlebane compares unfavorably.

items.name: Rundi's Dagger
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Rundi's Dagger is the weapon found besides its late eponymous owner, Rundi, east-southeast of Winterhold. Its appearance and stats are identical to those of a steel dagger, only being notable besides due to its unique name and owner.

items.name: Shiv
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: A Shiv is an improvised dagger-like weapon, commonly made and used by the prisoners of Cidhna Mine. These sharpened utensils are the only handily available weapon in the prison, excluding fists and magic.

items.name: Valdr's Lucky Dagger
items.effect: 25% chance of a critical hit.
items.where: Valdr's Lucky Dagger is a unique steel dagger given by the eponymous Valdr as a reward for helping him clear out Moss Mother Cavern, as part of its related quest. Its enchantment increases the chance of a critical hit by 25%.

items.name: Rulnik's Dagger
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Rulnik's Dagger is equipped by Rulnik Wind-Strider, who appears only if you select path of nothing in A Dying Wish.

items.name: Stormfang
items.effect: Target takes 30 points of shock damage, and half as much Magicka damage.
items.where: Stormfang is a steel greatsword wielded by a reaver lord found in Brodir Grove. It is identical to a normal steel greatsword in all respects.

items.name: Grand Champion's Sword
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Grand Champion's Sword is equipped by Neski Skull-Sabre, who appears only if you select path of power in A Dying Wish.

items.name: Horksbane
items.effect: Especially effective against horkers.
items.where: Horksbane is a steel mace found next to the corpse of Saden, its former owner, on Horker Island. It is identical to a normal steel mace in all respects.

items.name: Hoarfrost
items.effect: Targets take 15 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina, and have a small chance of being frozen solid.
items.where: Hoarfrost is an ancient Nordic pickaxe carried by Ralis Sedarys, who can be found in Kolbjorn Barrow. It is in all ways identical to a normal ancient Nordic pickaxe, and can be used to mine Stalhrim in place of one.

items.name: Notched Pickaxe
items.effect: Raises the wielder's Smithing abilities, and does 5 shock damage to enemies on hit.
items.where: The Notched Pickaxe is a special pickaxe found stuck into the peak of the Throat of the World. It has the unique enchantment Smithing Expertise, which boosts the Smithing skill while it is equipped, and does five points of shock damage when it is used as a weapon.

items.name: Bloodscythe
items.effect: When wielded with Soulrender, absorbs 15 health and has a chance to weaken enemy armor.
items.where: Bloodscythe is a scimitar which is one of the twin swords of the legendary Nord pirate captain Haknir Death-Brand. The sword can be found in Gyldenhul Barrow, next to the skeleton of its former owner in his burial chamber.

items.name: Bolar's Oathblade
items.effect: Does 25 points of Stamina damage.
items.where: Bolar's Oathblade is the Akaviri katana of the dead Blade Acilius Bolar. Its enchantment causes 25 points of stamina damage and twelve points of fear for thirty seconds.

items.name: Dragon's Oath
items.effect: Burns the target for 30 points. Targets on fire take extra damage.
items.where: Dragon's Oath is a unique one-handed sword. It is acquired through the Battle of the Champions quest.

items.name: Drainheart Sword
items.effect: Absorb 15 points of stamina.
items.where: A Drainheart Sword is a translucent Honed Ancient Nord Sword wielded by some of the ghostly draugr found within Labyrinthian. It is a part of a set of similar phantom weapons, alongside the Drainblood Battleaxe and Drainspell Bow.

items.name: Eduj
items.effect: Target takes 10 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
items.where: Eduj is a Nord Hero Sword that served as one of favored weapons of the Nord warrior Kvenel the Tongue, alongside the Nord Hero War Axe Okin. Eduj can be found in the possession of its owner within his tomb, Volunruud.

items.name: Ghostblade
items.effect: Does 3 points of extra damage, ignoring armor.
items.where: Ghostblade is a translucent Ancient Nord Sword given to you by the spirits of Fjori and Holgeir as a reward for freeing them from the control of Lu'ah Al-Skaven, as part of the quest Ansilvund. The weapon is enchanted to do three extra points of damage that ignore the target's armor, without needing to be charged through soul gems.

items.name: Master Sword
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: The Master Sword is a legendary sword obtained using amiibo or in a chest upon the Throat of the World. It is only available in the Nintendo Switch version of the game.

items.name: Red Eagle's Bane
items.effect: Undead up to level 13 are set on fire and flee for 30 seconds.
items.where: Red Eagle's Bane is an Ancient Nord Sword which serves as a reward for recovering Red Eagle's Fury and slaying the eponymous Red Eagle. Its enchantment does ten points of fire damage and turns undead that are at or lower than level thirteen for thirty seconds.

items.name: Soulrender
items.effect: When wielded with Bloodscythe, absorbs 15 magicka and has a chance to dispel magical defenses.
items.where: Soulrender is a scimitar which is one of the twin swords of the legendary Nord pirate captain Haknir Death-Brand. The sword can be found on the corpse of Haknir's ghost in Gyldenhul Barrow, after defeating him.

items.name: Storm-Bear Sword
items.effect: Target takes 30 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
items.where: Storm-Bear Sword is a unique sword. It is acquired through the Battle of the Champions quest.

items.name: Windshear
items.effect: Bash attacks made with this weapon have a chance of knocking enemies down.
items.where: Windshear is a unique Scimitar which can be found lodged inside of the bowsprit of The Katariah. As The Katariah cannot be accessed until the quest Hail Sithis! has begun, this weapon is similarly impossible to acquire until that quest has been started.

items.name: Namira's Itch
items.effect: Absorb 30 points of Stamina.
items.where: Namira's Itch is a unique war axe added by Alternative Armors - Dragon Plate. It can be obtained from Alvasorr the Rat.

items.name: Okin
items.effect: Target takes 10 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
items.where: Okin is a Nord Hero War Axe that served as one of favored weapons of the Nord warrior Kvenel the Tongue, Forged by Haman Forgefire to be used alongside the Nord Hero Sword Eduj. Okin can be found in the possession of its owner within his tomb, Volunruud.

items.name: Poacher's Axe
items.effect: 3 points of extra damage to Animals.
items.where: The Poacher's Axe is a special woodcutter's axe that is found within Halted Stream Camp. It has the unique enchantment Huntsman's Prowess, which does an additional three points of damage to animals.

items.name: Aegisbane
items.effect: Target takes 5 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
items.where: Aegisbane is an iron warhammer and the ancestral weapon of Clan Shatter-Shield. It had recently been stolen by the bandit Alain Dufont, who managed to get close to the clan through the seduction of a friend of the family, Muiri.

items.name: Akatosh's Talon
items.effect: Burns the target for 50 points. Targets on fire take extra damage.
items.where: Akatosh's Talon is a unique warhammer. It is acquired through the Battle of the Champions quest.

items.name: Champion's Cudgel
items.effect: 50% chance for each element of fire, frost, and shock to do 25 points of damage.
items.where: The Champion's Cudgel is a warhammer wielded by General Falx Carius who can be found in Fort Frostmoth. The head of the warhammer is made of steel, with the Imperial Legion symbol engraved on it.

items.name: The Longhammer
items.effect: Rahd's hammer, the reduced weight allows it to be swung more quickly.
items.where: The Longhammer is a unique Orcish warhammer that belonged to the bandit Rahd before he was killed during a Falmer attack as part of the related quest. It can be recovered from the Breton's dead grasp within Liar's Retreat.

items.name: Trollsbane
items.effect: Burns Trolls for 15 points.
items.where: Trollsbane is a steel warhammer and the signature weapon of Frofnir Trollsbane before he was slain inside a troll's lair between Cradle Stone Tower and Valthume. Its enchantment has the unique property to do fifteen points of fire damage to any troll it hits, although it will have no effect against any other kind of creature.

items.name: Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution
items.effect: Enemies who strike you with a melee attack have a small chance of being paralyzed.
items.where: Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution is the chest piece of a set of armor created by the legendary Nord enchanter Ahzidal. It can be found in Kolbjorn Barrow, after defeating its creator during Unearthed.

items.name: Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking
items.effect: Waterwalking. If you wear any four Relics of Ahzidal, +10 Enchanting.
items.where: Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking are a pair of boots that are part of a set of armor created by the legendary Nord enchanter Ahzidal. They can be found on a plinth in Kolbjorn Barrow, after the first phase of digging is completed during Unearthed.

items.name: Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding
items.effect: Your Wards are 25% less effective, but absorb 50% of the magicka from incoming spells.
items.where: Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding are a pair of gauntlets that are part of a set of armor created by the legendary Nord enchanter Ahzidal. They can be found in Kolbjorn Barrow, after the third phase of digging is completed during Unearthed.

items.name: Ahzidal's Helm of Vision
items.effect: Your Conjuration and Rune spells cost 25% more, but can be cast at greater range.
items.where: Ahzidal's Helm of Vision is an ancient Nord helmet that is part of a set of armor created by the legendary Nord enchanter Ahzidal. It can be found in Kolbjorn Barrow during Unearthed.

items.name: Ancient Helmet of the Unburned
items.effect: Increases Fire Resistance by 40%.
items.where: The Ancient Helmet of the Unburned is a unique Ancient Nord Helmet. It is located behind a locked gate in Labyrinthian, Tribune.

items.name: Ancient Shrouded Armor
items.effect: Increases Poison Resistance by 100%.
items.where: Ancient Shrouded Armor is the chest piece of a set of armor found on a dead assassin in Hag's End. Alongside this piece, this set of armor also includes boots, a cowl, and gloves.

items.name: Ancient Shrouded Boots
items.effect: Wearer is muffled and moves silently.
items.where: Ancient Shrouded Boots are the boots for a set of armor found on a dead assassin in Hag's End. Alongside this piece, this set of armor also includes an armor piece, a cowl, and gloves.

items.name: Ancient Shrouded Cowl
items.effect: Bows do 35% more damage.
items.where: Ancient Shrouded Cowl is the head piece for a set of armor found on a dead assassin in Hag's End. Alongside this piece, this set of armor also includes an armor piece, a pair of boots, and gloves.

items.name: Ancient Shrouded Gloves
items.effect: Double sneak attack damage with one-handed weapons.
items.where: Ancient Shrouded Gloves are the gloves for a set of armor found on a dead assassin in Hag's End. Alongside this piece, this set of armor also includes an armor piece, a pair of boots, and a cowl.

items.name: Blackguard's Armor
items.effect: Carrying capacity increased by 50 points.
items.where: The Blackguard's Armor is the chest piece of a set of armor that also includes boots, gloves and a hood. It can be found along with the rest of the set in the basement of Glover Mallory's house, however Mallory will only give you the key to his basement after you complete Paid in Full.

items.name: Blackguard's Boots
items.effect: Pickpocket success is 40% better.
items.where: The Blackguard's Boots are the boots of a set of armor that also includes a chestpiece, gloves and a hood. They can be found in the basement of Glover Mallory's house along with the rest of the set, however Mallory will only give you the key to his basement after you complete Paid in Full.

items.name: Blackguard's Gloves
items.effect: Lockpicking is 40% easier.
items.where: The Blackguard's Gloves are the gauntlets of a set of armor that also includes a chestpiece, boots and a hood. They can be found along with the rest of the set in the basement of Glover Mallory's house, however Mallory will only give you the key to his basement after you complete Paid in Full.

items.name: Blackguard's Hood
items.effect: Prices are 25% better.
items.where: The Blackguard's Hood is the hood of a set of armor that also includes a chestpiece, boots and gloves. It can be found along with the rest of the set in the basement of Glover Mallory's house, however Mallory will only give you the key to his basement after you complete Paid in Full.

items.name: Deathbrand Armor
items.effect: Increases your stamina by 15 for each Deathbrand item you wear.
items.where: The Deathbrand Armor is the chest piece of a set of armor that also includes boots, gauntlets and a helm. It can be found in a treasure chest that has been unearthed by reavers to the north-northwest of the Earth Stone, but only after you find the treasure map during the related quest.

items.name: Deathbrand Boots
items.effect: Increases your carrying capacity by 10 for each Deathbrand item you wear.
items.where: The Deathbrand Boots are the boots of a set of armor that also includes armor, gauntlets and a helm. They can be found in a treasure chest that has been unearthed by reavers to the north-northwest of the Earth Stone, but only after you find the treasure map during the related quest.

items.name: Deathbrand Gauntlets
items.effect: While dual-wielding, your one-handed attacks do 10% more damage for each Deathbrand item you wear.
items.where: The Deathbrand Gauntlets are the gauntlets of a set of armor that also includes armor, boots and a helm. They can be found in a treasure chest that has been unearthed by reavers to the north-northwest of the Earth Stone, but only after you find the treasure map during the related quest.

items.name: Deathbrand Helm
items.effect: Waterbreathing. +100 Armor while wearing a complete set of Deathbrand Armor.
items.where: The Deathbrand Helm is the helmet of a set of armor that also includes armor, boots and gauntlets. It can be found in a treasure chest that has been unearthed by reavers to the north-northwest of the Earth Stone, but only after you find the treasure map during the related quest.

items.name: Diadem of the Savant
items.effect: Spells in all schools cost less magicka to cast.
items.where: The Diadem of the Savant is a unique circlet that serves as the reward for conquering Shalidor's Maze, although a respawnable version can also be found outside of Froki's Shack (see bugs). As would be expected for an item associated with Shalidor, the circlet makes it so that all spells use less magicka.

items.name: General Tullius' Armor
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: General Tullius' Armor is the armor used by the eponymous General Tullius. The most distinguishing trait of this item is its appearance, with its gold trim and the ornate Imperial Legion symbols on it distinguish its owner as one of the highest ranking members of the Legion.

items.name: Gilded Wristguards
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Gilded Wristguards are unique gauntlets located inside The Katariah, inside the Emperor's Quarters. As they are located upon The Katariah, they cannot be acquired until the related quest Hail Sithis! has been started.

items.name: Gloves of the Pugilist
items.effect: Unarmed strikes do 10 additional damage.
items.where: The Gloves of the Pugilist are unique gloves located inside of the sewer tunnels beneath Riften known as The Ratway. Specifically, the Gloves of the Pugilist are found on the appropriately named Gian the Fist, who uses them for their unique fortify unarmed damage enchantment, which increases the damage unarmed strikes do by ten points.

items.name: Guild Master's Armor
items.effect: Carrying capacity increased by 50 points.
items.where: The Guild Master's Armor is the chest piece of the unique set of equipment given to the Guild Master of the Thieves Guild, and is the quest reward for completing Under New Management. Alongside this item, this set of equipment includes boots, gloves, and a hood.

items.name: Guild Master's Boots
items.effect: Pickpocket success is 35% better.
items.where: The Guild Master's Boots serve as the foot protection for the unique set of equipment given to the Guild Master of the Thieves Guild, and is part of the quest reward for completing Under New Management. Alongside this item, this set of equipment includes armor, gloves, and a hood.

items.name: Guild Master's Gloves
items.effect: Lockpicking is 35% easier.
items.where: The Guild Master's Gloves are the gauntlets for the unique set of equipment given to the Guild Master of the Thieves Guild, and is part of the quest reward for completing Under New Management. Alongside this item, this set of equipment includes armor, boots, and a hood.

items.name: Guild Master's Hood
items.effect: Prices are 20% better.
items.where: The Guild Master's Hood is the headwear for the unique set of equipment given to the Guild Master of the Thieves Guild, and is part of the quest reward for completing Under New Management. Alongside this item, this set of equipment includes armor, boots, and gloves.

items.name: Helm of Yngol
items.effect: Increases Frost Resistance by 30%.
items.where: The Helm of Yngol is a unique helmet that belonged to Yngol, one of the original members of the Companions. After his death, he and his helmet were locked away in Yngol Barrow.

items.name: Ironhand Gauntlets
items.effect: Two-handed attacks do 15% more damage.
items.where: The Ironhand Gauntlets are the gauntlets used by the bandit Hajvarr Iron-Hand, the leader of the bandits who operate out of White River Watch. The gauntlets themselves are actually steel Nordic gauntlets, despite their name.

items.name: Linwe's Armor
items.effect: Increases your stamina by 15 points.
items.where: Linwe's Armor is the chest piece of the unique set of equipment used by the leader of the Summerset Shadows, Linwe. Alongside this item, this set of equipment also includes a pair of boots, gloves, and a hood.

items.name: Linwe's Boots
items.effect: Sneaking is 15% better.
items.where: Linwe's Boots serve as the foot protection for the unique set of equipment used by the leader of the Summerset Shadows, Linwe. Alongside this item, this set of equipment also includes armor, a pair of gloves, and a hood.

items.name: Linwe's Gloves
items.effect: One-handed attacks do 15% more damage.
items.where: Linwe's Gloves serve as the gauntlets for the unique set of equipment used by the leader of the Summerset Shadows, Linwe. Alongside this item, this set of equipment also includes armor, a pair of boots, and a hood.

items.name: Linwe's Hood
items.effect: Bows do 15% more damage.
items.where: Linwe's Hood is the headwear for the unique set of equipment used by the leader of the Summerset Shadows, Linwe. Alongside this item, this set of equipment also includes armor, a pair of boots, and a gloves.

items.name: Movarth's Boots
items.effect: Sneaking is 15% better.
items.where: Movarth's Boots are a set of hide boots owned by the vampire Movarth Piquine. The boots can be found in their owner's lair, in the northeastern portion of the cave, next to a bed.

items.name: Armor of the Old Gods
items.effect: Destruction spells cost 15% less to cast.
items.where: The Armor of the Old Gods is a special version of Forsworn Armor given to you by Kaie for helping the leader of the Forsworn, Madanach, escape Cidhna Mine. Alongside the chest piece, this armor set also includes a pair of boots, gauntlets, and a helmet.

items.name: Boots of the Old Gods
items.effect: Sneaking is 20% better.
items.where: The Boots of the Old Gods are a special version of Forsworn Boots given to you by Kaie for helping the leader of the Forsworn, Madanach, escape Cidhna Mine. Alongside these shoes, this armor set also includes a chest piece, a pair of gauntlets, and a helmet.

items.name: Gauntlets of the Old Gods
items.effect: Bows do 20% more damage.
items.where: The Gauntlets of the Old Gods are a special version of Forsworn Gauntlets given to you by Kaie for helping the leader of the Forsworn, Madanach, escape Cidhna Mine. Alongside this wristwear, this armor set also includes a chest piece, a pair of boots, and a helmet.

items.name: Helmet of the Old Gods
items.effect: Increases your Magicka by 30 points.
items.where: The Helmet of the Old Gods is a special version of a Forsworn Headdress given to you by Kaie for helping the leader of the Forsworn, Madanach, escape Cidhna Mine. Alongside this headdress, this armor set also includes a chest piece, a pair of boots, and a pair of gauntlets.

items.name: Predator's Grace
items.effect: Wearer is muffled and moves silently.
items.where: Predator's Grace is a pair of hide boots that are found next to a chest, above a waterfall, to the right of the Hag's End top level. These unique boots fully muffle the sound of movement the wearer makes, while also increasing the rate of stamina regeneration by one percent.

items.name: Shrouded Armor
items.effect: Increases Poison Resistance by 50%.
items.where: Shrouded Armor is the chest piece of a set of armor used by the Dark Brotherhood. Alongside this piece, this set of armor also includes boots, a cowl, and gloves.

items.name: Shrouded Boots
items.effect: Wearer is muffled and moves silently.
items.where: Shrouded Boots are the boots for a set of armor used by the Dark Brotherhood. Alongside these shoes, this set of armor also includes armor, a cowl, and gloves.

items.name: Shrouded Cowl
items.effect: Bows do 20% more damage.
items.where: A Shrouded Cowl serves as the helmet for a set of armor used by the Dark Brotherhood. Alongside this veil, this set of armor also includes armor, boots, and gloves.

items.name: Shrouded Gloves
items.effect: Backstab does double damage.
items.where: Shrouded Gloves serve as the gauntlets for a set of armor used by the Dark Brotherhood. Alongside these gloves, this set of armor also includes armor, boots, and a cowl.

items.name: Thieves Guild Armor
items.effect: Carrying capacity increased by 20/35 (improved) points.
items.where: Thieves Guild Armor serves as the chest piece for the set of armor used by Thieves Guild members. Alongside this armor, this set of equipment also includes boots, gloves, and a hood.

items.name: Thieves Guild Boots
items.effect: Pickpocket success is 15/25% (improved) better.
items.where: Thieves Guild Boots are the shoes for the set of armor used by Thieves Guild members. Alongside these boots, this set of equipment also includes armor, gloves, and a hood.

items.name: Thieves Guild Gloves
items.effect: Lockpicking is 15/25% (improved) easier.
items.where: Thieves Guild Gloves are the gauntlets for the set of armor used by Thieves Guild members. Alongside these gloves, this set of equipment also includes armor, boots, and a hood.

items.name: Thieves Guild Hood
items.effect: Prices are 10/15% (improved) better.
items.where: A Thieves Guild Hood serves as the helmet for the set of armor used by Thieves Guild members. Alongside this hood, this set of equipment also includes armor, boots, and gloves.

items.name: Torturer's Hood
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: The Torturer's Hood is a helmet used by certain dubious figures, such as the torturer encountered in Helgen. It shares its appearance with a generic Thieves Guild Hood.

items.name: Tumblerbane Gloves
items.effect: Lockpicking is 20% easier.
items.where: Tumblerbane Gloves are a special version of Shrouded Gloves given to you for refurbishing the Dawnstar Sanctuary with a master bedroom. The gloves can be found at the foot of the newly purchased bed.

items.name: Ulfric's Bracers
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Ulfric's Bracers are the gauntlets used by the eponymous Ulfric Stormcloak. They share their basic design with fine armguards, although they are made out of different materials.

items.name: Visage of Mzund
items.effect: Increases your stamina by 60 points and allows wearer to release the Breath of Nchuak, a powerful steam attack.
items.where: The Visage of Mzund is a unique Dwarven Helmet that is found within a treasure room in the Fahlbtharz Grand Hall. This helmet fortifies your stamina by 60 points, while also adding the lesser power Breath of Nchuak.

items.name: Wuuthrad
items.effect: Especially deadly to elves.
items.where: Wuuthrad is an ancient battleaxe once wielded by the founder of the Companions, Ysgramor. Ysgramor carried the axe when he and the Five Hundred Companions drove the elves from Skyrim and Solstheim.

items.name: Auriel's Bow
items.effect: 20 points of sun damage. Undead targets take triple damage.
items.where: Auriel's Bow is a powerful bow allegedly used by the elven god Auri-El. It is received from Gelebor during the quest Touching the Sky.

items.name: Dwarven Black Bow of Fate
items.effect: Absorb Health 25 points; Absorb Magicka 25 points; Absorb Stamina 25 points.
items.where: The Dwarven Black Bow of Fate is a unique Dwarven bow found in the Dwarven ruin of Kagrumez after completing all three puzzles. The bow has a similar structural shape to a regular Dwarven bow, except that it is made of ebony and its color scheme is much darker.

items.name: Nightingale Bow
items.effect: Freezes the target for 30 points and shocks the target for 15 points.
items.where: The Nightingale Bow is a bow given to you by Karliah as a reward for completing the quest Blindsighted. Its enchantment causes instantaneous frost damage, shock damage over one second, and slows the target down for three seconds.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Keening
items.effect: Drain Magicka 10 points; Absorb Health 10 points; Absorb Stamina 10 points.
items.where: Keening is a unique dagger crafted by the Dwemer Lord Kagrenac. Keening, Sunder and Wraithguard are the three legendary tools created to control the Heart of Lorkhan.

items.name: Bloodskal Blade
items.effect: Releases energy blast with power attacks that deals 30 damage.
items.where: The Bloodskal Blade is a two-handed greatsword found in Bloodskal Barrow on the corpse of Gratian Caerellius. Its power attack shoots out an arc of red energy, depending on the direction of the slash.

items.name: Aetherial Staff
items.effect: Summon a Dwarven Spider or Sphere for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
items.where: The Aetherial Staff is a staff created at the Aetherium Forge as one of three possible rewards for Lost to the Ages. The appearance of the staff is similar to the Spider Control Rod, but with an aqua-blue crystal made of Aetherium.

items.name: Miraak's Staff
items.effect: Sprays writhing tentacles on the ground that stagger and poison foes that enter them.
items.where: Miraak's Staff is found on Miraak's corpse during the quest At the Summit of Apocrypha. It sprays writhing tentacles on the ground that stagger and poison foes that enter them, giving the staff a unique effect similar to the Destruction school's wall spells.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Staff of Magnus
items.effect: Absorb 20 magicka per second. If the target is out of magicka, absorb health instead.
items.where: The Staff of Magnus is found on the body of the dragon priest Morokei, encountered in Labyrinthian during the quest of the same name.

items.name: Chillrend
items.effect: Target takes 30 points of frost damage.
items.where: Chillrend is a unique glass sword found during The Pursuit in Mercer Frey's house in a display case with an expert-level lock. It deals frost damage as well as having a chance to paralyze anything it strikes.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Dragonbane
items.effect: 40 points of extra damage to dragons, 10 points of shock damage to others.
items.where: Dragonbane is an Akaviri katana found in Sky Haven Temple. As the name would suggest, Dragonbane does additional damage to dragons if used against them.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Harkon's Sword
items.effect: Absorbs 15 points of Health, Magicka, and Stamina if wielded by a vampire.
items.where: Harkon's Sword is a one-handed sword carried by Lord Harkon. It can be acquired through either pickpocketing or by killing him when completing the Dawnguard add-on's main questline.

items.name: Miraak's Sword
items.effect: Absorb 15 points of stamina.
items.where: Miraak's Sword is carried by Miraak. It is obtainable from his corpse at the end of At the Summit of Apocrypha.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Nightingale Blade
items.effect: Absorb 25 points of health and 25 points of stamina per second from the target.
items.where: The Nightingale Blade is a sword, originally owned by Gallus, given to you by Karliah during the quest Hard Answers. Its enchantment absorbs the health and stamina of whoever is slashed by it for one second.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Dawnguard Rune Axe
items.effect: Sun Damage, 0–100 pts in 15 ft.
items.where: The Dawnguard Rune Axe is a powerful war axe received as part of the Lost Relic quest. It is the only artifact in the game that is a war axe.

items.name: Dawnguard Rune Hammer
items.effect: Bashing places a rune on a nearby surface; the rune explodes for 50 points of fire damage when enemies come near.
items.where: The Dawnguard Rune Hammer is a powerful warhammer received as part of the Lost Relic quest. Its enchantment gives you the unique defensive ability to create a Fire Rune by bashing with the hammer while aiming at the surface the rune is to be placed upon, however the range at which the rune can be placed is not particularly long unless you have the Destruction perk Rune Master.

items.name: Ruin's Edge
items.effect: Randomly applies one of these effects to the target.
items.where: Ruin's Edge is a dark bow artifact with an animated eyeball just above the grip. It is acquired through the quest The Edge of Ruin, which has you claim the bow from bandits in Stony Creek Cave.

items.name: Chrysamere
items.effect: When equipped grants 15% resist fire, 10% absorb magic, slow health regen during combat.
items.where: Chrysamere is a greatsword artifact. It is acquired through The Lost Paladin quest, which has you claim the sword from the Lost Paladin at Forelhost.

items.name: Ice Blade of the Monarch
items.effect: Target takes 30 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
items.where: The Ice Blade of the Monarch is a greatsword artifact. It is acquired through the Caught in a Web quest.

items.name: Sword of Jyggalag
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: The Sword of Jyggalag is an artifact associated with Jyggalag, the Daedric Prince of Order. It can be found in the Solitude Sewers at the end of the related quest, and can be given to Staada as part of her quest.

items.name: Umbra
items.effect: If target dies within 20 seconds, fills a soul gem. Absorb 25 points of health. Absorb 25 points of stamina.
items.where: The Umbra Sword was enchanted by the ancient witch Naenra Waerr, and its sole purpose was the entrapment of souls. Used in conjunction with a soul gem, the Sword allows the wielder the opportunity to imprison an enemy's soul in the gem.

items.name: Mace of the Crusader
items.effect: Burns the target for 15 points. Targets on fire take extra damage.
items.where: The Mace of the Crusader is a mace artifact. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, which has you claim the mace and other relics from the Bandit Thieves at the Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Sunder
items.effect: Does 5 points of frost, fire, and shock damage each. Does 15 points of damage to stamina and magicka.
items.where: Sunder is a Dwemer artifact created by Kagrenac, one of the three tools used to siphon the power of the Heart of Lorkhan. Together with Wraithguard, it is acquired through the Legends Lost quest which has you claim them from the Sightless Vault.

items.name: Staff of Hasedoki
items.effect: If target dies within 60 seconds, fills a soul gem. Knocks back the target on impact. While not attacking, creates a ward that protects against spell for up to 40 points. Soul Trap, for 60 seconds Knockback, 1.
items.where: The Staff of Hasedoki is an artifact created by the great mage Hasedoki, who had no equal during his time. His soul powers the staff, and provides powerful defensive capabilities.

items.name: Staff of Sheogorath
items.effect: Targets that fail to resist are paralyzed for 10 seconds.
items.where: The Staff of Sheogorath is an artifact of the Daedric Prince Sheogorath, which can be obtained through the quest Put A Fork In It. The staff is able to paralyze any targets who fail to resist its area of effect.

items.name: Blackwater Blade
items.effect: Absorb 30 points of stamina.
items.where: Blackwater Blade is a Cyrodiilic steel pirate artifact associated with the Blackwater Brigands. It is carried by Celeste, the leader of the Blackwater Brigands.

items.name: Bloodthirst
items.effect: Absorb 15 points of health. Increases speed by 7%. Targets take additional bleed damage.
items.where: Bloodthirst is an Akaviri artifact created by the Tsaesci. It is similar to Dawnfang/Duskfang, and is acquired from a miscellaneous quest obtained from reading a note during the A Soul Divided quest.

items.name: Dawnfang and Duskfang
items.effect: In daytime, deals 7 points of fire damage. At night, deals 7 points of frost damage. After killing 12 creatures, absorbs 5 points of health or magicka. X creatures killed.
items.where: Dawnfang and Duskfang is an Akaviri artifact created by the Tsaesci. During the day, it is Dawnfang and deals fire damage, at night it transforms to Duskfang and deals frost damage.

items.name: Sword of the Crusader
items.effect: Burns the target for 15 points. Targets on fire take extra damage.
items.where: The Sword of the Crusader is a Sword artifact. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, which has you claim the sword and other relics from the Bandit Thieves at the Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Torment
items.effect: Burns the target for 30 points. Targets on fire take extra damage.
items.where: Torment is a unique sword, wielded by Valkyn Methats in the Deadlands. Its enchantment deals fire damage.

items.name: Nerveshatter
items.effect: Target takes 30 points of shock damage, and half as much Magicka damage.
items.where: Nerveshatter is a Daedric artifact composed of Madness Ore and Amber found in Crystaldrift Cave as part of the Nerveshatter quest. Like generic weapons "of Storms", it does 30 points of Shock Damage to its targets.

items.name: Stendarr's Hammer
items.effect: Damages the target for 22 points. Depletes 20 Stamina from wielder per hit.
items.where: Stendarr's Hammer is a unique Warhammer associated with the deity Stendarr. The hammer is acquired through a quest which involves stealing it from the Dwemer Museum in Markarth.

items.name: Shadowrend
items.effect: Target is 15% weaker to magic for 30 seconds.
items.where: Shadowrend is a Daedric artifact that can take the form of a greatsword or battleaxe. You can find it in Eastmarch switching back and forth in form.

items.name: Miraak's Boots
items.effect: Adds 5% to the dragon breath and spell absorption of Miraak's Robes.
items.where: Miraak's Boots are a pair of boots worn by Miraak. They are classified as Light Armor.

items.name: Miraak's Gloves
items.effect: Adds 5% to the dragon breath and spell absorption of Miraak's Robes.
items.where: Miraak's Gloves are a pair of gauntlets worn by Miraak. They are classified as Light Armor.

items.name: Aetherial Shield
items.effect: Enemies struck by this shield become ethereal for 15 seconds, making them unable to attack or be attacked.
items.where: The Aetherial Shield is made at the Aetherium Forge as one of three possible rewards for Lost to the Ages. It turns enemies ethereal for 10 seconds (see bugs) when bashed so they cannot be harmed or harm you, and also causes them to flee in fear.

items.name: Auriel's Shield
items.effect: Stores the energy of blocked attacks. Performing a power bash will release the stored energy.
items.where: Auriel's Shield is a powerful shield allegedly created and used by the elven god Auri-El. It can be found wielded by a Falmer Warmonger in the Forgotten Vale Forest after using the Ruby Paragon on the paragon portal.

items.name: Dawnguard Rune Shield
items.effect: +10 Bash damage against vampires, and sustained blocking creates a minor sun shield doing 10 points of damage while draining the wielder's stamina.
items.where: The Dawnguard Rune Shield is a powerful shield received as part of the Lost Relic quest. When you block with this shield, an aura similar to Stendarr's Aura will appear around you that does harm to undead.

items.name: Shield of Ysgramor
items.effect: Resist Magic 20 points; Fortify Health 20 points.
items.where: The Shield of Ysgramor is an artifact found in Ysgramor's Tomb, both being named in honor of Ysgramor. Besides its uses as a shield, the artifact also confers its enchantment while equipped.

items.name: Targe of the Blooded
items.effect: When bashing, does 3 points of bleeding damage for 5 seconds.
items.where: Targe of the Blooded is a unique shield wielded by Umana, a female Redguard who is part of a group of adventurers in the Dwemer ruin of Alftand. Although the shield has no magical enchantments, it does have large steel spikes that will cause bleeding damage when using the shield to bash opponents.

items.name: Ahzidal
items.effect: Increases Fire Resistance by 50% and Fire spell damage by 25%.
items.where: Ahzidal is the mask of the eponymous dragon priest, found within Kolbjorn Barrow. It gives the wearer a constant increase in fire damage by 25%, as well as 50% fire resistance.

items.name: Dukaan
items.effect: Increases Frost Resistance by 50% and Frost spell damage by 25%.
items.where: Dukaan is the mask of the eponymous dragon priest, found within White Ridge Sanctum. It gives the wearer a constant increase in frost damage by 25%, as well as 50% frost resistance.

items.name: Hevnoraak
items.effect: Immune to disease and poison.
items.where: Hevnoraak is an iron dragon priest mask gained by killing Hevnoraak within the Nordic Ruin of Valthume. The enchantment provides poison and disease immunity for all diseases and poisons except for ones that ignore disease and poison resistance.

items.name: Konahrik
items.effect: When health is low, has a chance to heal wearer and damage nearby enemies.
items.where: Konahrik is a golden dragon priest mask gained by obtaining all other masks from the base game and bringing them to Bromjunaar Sanctuary.

items.name: Krosis
items.effect: Lockpicking, Archery, and Alchemy are 20% better.
items.where: Krosis is a bronze dragon priest mask gained by killing the eponymous Krosis upon Shearpoint, a dragon lair. The mask's enchantment improves the user's Alchemy, Archery, and Lockpicking skills by twenty points.

items.name: Miraak
items.effect: Increases your Magicka by 70 points.
items.where: Miraak is a mask worn by the dragon priest of the same name. There are six versions available to you.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Morokei
items.effect: Magicka regenerates 100% faster.
items.where: Morokei is a moonstone dragon priest mask gained by killing Morokei within Labyrinthian. The mask's enchantment doubles magicka regeneration.

items.name: Nahkriin
items.effect: +50 Magicka, and Destruction and Restoration spells cost 20% less.
items.where: Nahkriin is an ebony dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Nahkriin, who is encountered during the main quest at Skuldafn. It is imbued with an enchantment that grants the wearer a Fortify Magicka effect that gives the wearer an additional fifty points of magicka.

items.name: Otar
items.effect: Resistance against fire, frost, and shock is improved.
items.where: Otar is a malachite dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Otar the Mad within the Nordic ruin, Ragnvald. The artifact's enchantment grants 30 points of shock, fire, and frost resistance.

items.name: Rahgot
items.effect: Increases your stamina by 70 points.
items.where: Rahgot is an orichalcum dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Rahgot within the Nordic ruin, Forelhost. The artifact's enchantment increases your stamina by 70 points.

items.name: Vokun
items.effect: Conjuration, Illusion and Alteration spells cost 20% less magicka to cast.
items.where: Vokun is a steel dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Vokun within High Gate Ruins. The artifact's enchantments increase your Alteration, Conjuration, and Illusion skills by twenty points when worn.

items.name: Volsung
items.effect: Prices are 20% better, Carry 20 points more, and can breathe underwater.
items.where: Volsung is a corundum dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Volsung at the end of the Nordic ruin, Volskygge. The artifact's enchantment allows you to breathe underwater, carry an additional twenty units of weight, and increases your bartering abilities by twenty points.

items.name: Wooden Mask
items.effect: The wooden mask hums with an unfamiliar energy.
items.where: The Wooden Mask is a dragon priest mask found in the exterior of Labyrinthian inside what was a perfectly round but is now a ruined building. It is alongside a long-forgotten note, the Hired Thug's Missive and presumably the owner's skeleton.

items.name: Zahkriisos
items.effect: Increases Shock Resistance by 50% and Shock spell damage by 25%.
items.where: Zahkriisos is the mask of the eponymous dragon priest, found within Raven Rock Mine. It gives the wearer a constant increase in shock damage by 25%, as well as 50% shock resistance.

items.name: Cuirass of the Crusader
items.effect: 10% Armor bonus, and 10% reduced damage from undead while wearing matched set. Increase your health by 10 points. Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast.
items.where: The Cuirass of the Crusader is an artifact cuirass. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Dragonbone Mail
items.effect: Increases Fire Resistance by 100%.
items.where: The Dragonbone Mail is a heavy artifact armor added by Alternative Armors - Dragon Plate. Improving it requires one dragon bone and the Arcane Blacksmith perk.

items.name: Lord's Mail
items.effect: Opponents in melee range have 5 points of health absorbed per second. Increases Poison Resistance by 75%. Increases Magic Resistance by 17%.
items.where: The Lord's Mail is an artifact created by Kynareth. It is heavy armor and enchanted with poison resistance, magic resistance, as well as a unique area effect that inflicts 5 points of health absorption per second on nearby opponents.

items.name: Reforged Cuirass of the Crusader
items.effect: 10% Armor bonus, and 10% reduced damage from undead while wearing matched set. Increase your health by 10 points. Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast.
items.where: The Reforged Cuirass of the Crusader is an artifact cuirass. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Boots of the Crusader
items.effect: Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast.
items.where: The Boots of the Crusader are artifact boots. They are acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Reforged Boots of the Crusader
items.effect: Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast.
items.where: The Reforged Boots of the Crusader are artifact boots. They are acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Fists of Randagulf
items.effect: Melee and unarmed attacks do 20% more damage. Block 20% more damage with your shield.
items.where: The Fists of Randagulf are artifact gauntlets originally worn by Randagulf, one of the mightiest warriors from Skyrim in Tamrielic history. It is heavy armor and enchanted with the following: Melee and unarmed attacks do 20% more damage.

items.name: Gauntlets of the Crusader
items.effect: Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast. Increases Disease Resistance by 50%.
items.where: The Gauntlets of the Crusader are artifact gauntlets. They are acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Reforged Gauntlets of the Crusader
items.effect: Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast. Increases Disease Resistance by 50%.
items.where: The Reforged Gauntlets of the Crusader are artifact gauntlets. They are acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Wraithguard
items.effect: Resist shock, fire, frost, magic, disease, and poison by 10%. Empowers Keening and Sunder when equipped.
items.where: Wraithguard is a Dwemer artifact created by Kagrenac, one of the three tools that was used to siphon the power of the Heart of Lorkhan. It is heavy armor and enchanted with the following: Resist shock, fire, frost, magic, disease, and poison by 10%.

items.name: Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
items.effect: Sneaking is 25% better. Nearby living creatures, but not undead, machines or daedra, can be seen through walls. Turns guards hostile.
items.where: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal is a Daedric artifact helmet which once belonged to the Daedric Prince Nocturnal before being stolen. It is acquired through the quest The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal.

items.name: Helm of the Crusader
items.effect: Illusion spells cost 10% less to cast. Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast. Prices are 8% better.
items.where: The Helm of the Crusader is an artifact helmet. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Reforged Helm of the Crusader
items.effect: Illusion spells cost 10% less to cast. Restoration spells cost 8% less to cast. Prices are 8% better.
items.where: The Reforged Helm of the Crusader is an artifact helmet. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Shield of the Crusader
items.effect: While blocking, creates a ward that protects against spells for up to 40 points.
items.where: The Shield of the Crusader is an artifact shield. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Fastened Shield of the Crusader
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: The Fastened Shield of the Crusader is an artifact. It is acquired through the Relics of the Crusader quest, in which you also claim the other relics from the Bandit Thieves at Four Skull Lookout.

items.name: Amulet of Articulation
items.effect: Persuade checks in dialogue will almost always succeed and Speechcraft is 35% better.
items.where: The Amulet of Articulation is an amulet artifact given to you by Brynjolf for becoming the new Guildmaster of the Thieves Guild in the quest Under New Management. Its enchantment grants a unique bonus to Speech, which increases the chance of successfully persuading someone.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Necromancer Amulet
items.effect: +50 magicka, Conjuration spells cost 25% less to cast, Health and Stamina regen 75% slower.
items.where: The Necromancer Amulet is a legendary artifact created by the King of Worms, Mannimarco. The wearer becomes wise beyond their years and far more capable in the School of Conjuration.

items.name: Aetherial Crown
items.effect: Retains the last Standing Stone ability you held, granting you its effects in addition to those of your current Stone.
items.where: The Aetherial Crown is created at The Aetherium Forge as one of three possible rewards for Lost to the Ages. It retains your previous Standing Stone power whenever you choose a new one, meaning that while you wear it, you can have two Standing Stone powers active at the same time.

items.name: Denstagmer's Ring
items.effect: Resistance against fire, frost, and shock is improved by 20%.
items.where: Denstagmer's Ring is a ring artifact. It can be found while fishing.

items.name: Mentor's Ring
items.effect: All spells cost 10% less magicka to cast.
items.where: The Mentor's Ring is a ring artifact.

items.name: Ring of Khajiit
items.effect: You move 10% faster. Allows you to cast the spell Hide.
items.where: The Ring of Khajiit is a ring artifact associated with both Mephala and Meridia. Ri'saad will give it to you as a reward for completing the quest Spirits Away.

items.name: Ring of Phynaster
items.effect: Resist Shock 20 points; Resist Magic 20 points; Resist Poison 20 points.
items.where: The Ring of Phynaster is a ring artifact. It can be caught randomly at fishing spots across Skyrim.

items.name: Ring of Surroundings
items.effect: Sneaking is 20% better.
items.where: The Ring of Surroundings is a ring artifact obtained from completing the quest Clear-Headed.

items.name: Ring of the Wind
items.effect: You move 15% faster.
items.where: The Ring of the Wind is a ring artifact. It can be found while fishing.

items.name: Vampiric Ring
items.effect: Allows you to cast the spell Drain Life.
items.where: The Vampiric Ring is a ring artifact. It is obtained through the quest Tusked Terror.

items.name: Warlock's Ring
items.effect: While blocking, creates a ward that protects against spells for up to 25 points. Health regenerates 30% faster. You move 5% faster.
items.where: The Warlock's Ring is a unique ring. You will need to fish it up from a fishing spot east of Morthal during the quest No Contest.

items.name: Archmage's Robes
items.effect: All spells cost 15% less to cast, +50 magicka, and magicka regenerates 100% faster.
items.where: The Archmage's Robes are a set of hooded robes that are awarded to you after completing The Eye of Magnus. They provide boosts to all magic based skills except Enchanting, plus bonuses to magicka and magicka regeneration.

items.name: Miraak's Robes
items.effect: Absorb 15% of the magicka from dragon breath and spells. Chance on hit to spawn a tentacle explosion.
items.where: Miraak's Robes are a set of robes worn by Miraak. They can be obtained after defeating Miraak during At the Summit of Apocrypha.

items.name: The White Phial
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: The White Phial is a legendary bottle, forged in the days when Skyrim was just starting its turn to ice. A small container, made of the magically infused snow that first fell on the Throat of the World.

items.name: Gauldur Blackblade
items.effect: Absorb 25 points of health.
items.where: The Gauldur Blackblade is a Honed Ancient Nord Sword found at Folgunthur in the possession of Mikrul Gauldurson. The weapon's enchantment absorbs health from whoever is slashed by it over one second.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Gauldur Blackbow
items.effect: Absorb 30 points of magicka.
items.where: The Gauldur Blackbow is a special ancient Nord bow found at Geirmund's Hall in the possession of Sigdis Gauldurson. The weapon's enchantment drains magicka from whoever is hit by one of its arrows for one second.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Lunar Iron Mace
items.effect: While the moons are out, burns the target for 20 points.
items.where: The Lunar Iron Mace is a special iron mace that can be occasionally found at Silent Moons Camp. Its enchantment causes light damage over one second on whoever is struck by the mace.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: The Pale Blade
items.effect: Targets take 25 points of frost damage and 50 points of Stamina damage. Weaker creatures and people flee for 30 seconds.
items.where: The Pale Blade is a sword rewarded to you for completing The Pale Lady. The sword's enchantment causes instantaneous frost damage, and also inflicts its target with fear for thirty seconds.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Tsun's Battle Axe
items.effect: No enchantment.
items.where: Tsun's Battle Axe is the primary weapon for the shield-thane of Shor, Tsun. The weapon lacks any enchantment and is unobtainable through any means except the console.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Nightingale Armor
items.effect: Increases your stamina by 40 points.
items.where: Nightingale Armor is part of a set of light armor given to you for joining the Nightingales. Its enchantment grants a Fortify Stamina and Resist Frost effect.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Nightingale Boots
items.effect: Wearer is muffled and moves silently.
items.where: The Nightingale Boots are part of a set of armor given to you for joining the Nightingales. Its enchantment grants a Muffle effect.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Nightingale Gloves
items.effect: Lockpicking is 25% easier.
items.where: The Nightingale Gloves are part of a set of armor given to you for joining the Nightingales. Its enchantment grants a Fortify Lockpicking and Fortify One-handed effect, making Lockpicking less of a challenge and making you more deadly with One-handed weapons.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Nightingale Hood
items.effect: Illusion spells cost 17% less to cast.
items.where: The Nightingale Hood is part of a set of armor given to you for joining the Nightingales. Its enchantment grants a Fortify Illusion effect, which decreases the cost of Illusion spells.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Shield of Solitude
items.effect: Increases Magic Resistance by 30%.
items.where: The Shield of Solitude is a shield given to you by Falk Firebeard for saving Skyrim from the return of the Wolf Queen in The Wolf Queen Awakened. It is identical in appearance to a Solitude Guard's Shield.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.

items.name: Mage's Circlet
items.effect: Increases your Magicka by 70 points.
items.where: The Mage's Circlet is a circlet given to you by Savos Aren for alerting him of the need to acquire The Staff of Magnus to stop an impending disaster, in the quest Good Intentions. Its enchantment grants a Fortify Magicka effect, which increases your available Magicka pool.
items.note: Its strength is set by your level when you first get it, so picking it up later can mean a stronger version.
